title: Camera controls panel with device dropdown and sensitivity slider
description: Implement web/src/components/CameraControls.jsx containing camera source dropdown selector, detection sensitivity slider with 'More Sensitive' and 'Less Sensitive' labels, and overlay toggle switch.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown populates with available camera devices from GET /api/camera/devices
Changing selected camera invokes POST /api/camera/start with new device index
Sensitivity slider allows adjustments (0.5 to 1.5) with clear labels 'Less Sensitive' and 'More Sensitive'
Overlay toggle controls visual boxes without stopping stream
All form controls have accessible labels and keyboard focus states (PRD 6.6)

steps.details: Create web/src/components/CameraControls.jsx with device selector, sensitivity slider, and toggle controls.

steps.description: Implement API integration for device change and settings
steps.details: Fetch devices on mount, handle camera switch, and dispatch PUT /api/settings when sensitivity changes (debounced by 300ms).
Style form controls with custom sliders, clean focus outlines, and accessible field labels.
Run Playwright test verifying dropdown and slider change events; capture screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-27-1.png.

technicalNotes: Debounce slider changes to avoid flooding the backend settings endpoint.
Handle camera busy or permission denied errors with an inline alert banner.
